coverage.cucumber_greenhouse: Nine distinct conditions selected: five inline plus mosaic virus, root rot, slugs and fruitlet failure. Powdery-mildew and grey/stem-rot aliases covered; fruit-virus symptoms grouped with mosaic. No-fruit pollination advice for marrows not applied to unpollinated greenhouse cucumbers. Lower-priority anthracnose, gummosis, eelworm and separate stem-rot identities retained for specialist diagnosis. Bitter-fruit disposal retained explicitly. Soil/care balance humidity with airflow and free drainage; training, flower handling and organic feeding retained. Heated/unheated sowing and planting windows combined in one complete note.
coverage.cucumber_outdoor: Nine distinct outdoor problems: all five inline plus bitter fruit, root rot, botrytis and fruit set. Slugs/woodlice row combines original damage context with observation; aliases are not extra rows. Specialist rots, anthracnose, mites mainly under glass and out-of-scope squash storage advice remain in source. Care follows named variety pollination requirements rather than universal male-flower removal. Caption already covers warm direct sowing, intact roots and frost; notes add protected germination temperatures with paired units. Original slug-pellet optional source note is not printed and is logged for later scoped replacement.
coverage.marrow_courgette: Seven distinct useful UK problems: four common inline conditions plus mosaic, root rot and bitter fruit. Legacy vine borer is retained at low priority pending geographic/source diagnosis, not promoted as routine UK advice. Shared no-fruit/withering and mildew aliases covered; rarer rots and greenhouse mites not duplicated. Care and harvest retain pollination, trailing support, tender courgettes versus mature storage marrows and skin-irritation precautions. Direct/under-cover timing and trailing route assessed together; all safe advice remains in master.
